blade.name: BLADE

shadow.name: SHADOW
shadow.pitch: THE SHADOW ARTS: DASH THROUGH THEIR LINES, CHOKE THEM IN POISON, STRIKE FROM BEHIND.

cleric.name: CLERIC

ranger.name: RANGER
